notes: Tier shelf, four kinds. Security camera: old k41's 10 SKUs cut to 12 models, one per brand across Nest (two: indoor wired and battery), Wyze, Eufy, Blink, Ring, Arlo, Reolink, TP-Link Tapo, Swann plus independent test picks (Aqara G350 from TechRadar; Eufy 4G LTE S330, Tapo C246D, Nest Cam from Tom's Guide; Arlo Pro 5S, Blink Outdoor 4 from Security.org); old sub-types became 't' types (indoor, outdoor battery, wired/PoE, pan-tilt, solar, LTE, dual-lens). Old models not confirmed on a retrieved page (Arlo Go 2, Eufy C120/E30, Reolink E1 Pro, Kasa KC410S, Tapo C325WB/C420S2/C210, Wyze Window Cam) were dropped as SKU noise. Floodlight camera trimmed to eight test-confirmed models (Reviewed, SafeWise). Camera system kit + NVR merged into 'Wired camera system' with brand ranges (Lorex, Swann, Reolink, Annke, Hikvision, Zmodo per Security.org wired ranking) rather than SKUs. Dummy camera added as a new kind sourced to Wikipedia's Fake security camera article, with models from Family Handyman's tested list. Brand register: 12 entries; founding years left blank for Eufy, Wyze, Annke and Hikvision because retrieved pages did not state them. No traditions apply. Eufy's register source is the Anker Wikipedia page (no Eufy article; Wikidata Q135488160 has no inception/country).
